translations.web: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
translations.bsb: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
translations.kjv: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
translations.asv: Concerning therefore the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no God but one.
